actions.name: mic_start
actions.description: Start capturing the microphone and stream raw PCM to a peer as AudioStreamChunk envelopes (device, rate, channels, chunk size all optional). Open-ended live capture of the room until mic_stop.

target.description: Peer slug that receives the captured PCM as AudioStreamChunk envelopes (e.g. "stt", or a client speaker slug). Must be on the operator's MIC_PLUGIN_IPC_TARGETS allowlist.

format.description: Capture format; only s16le raw PCM in v0.1 (the D-12 codec every consumer decodes). Default: pcm_s16le.

device.description: Capture device/source name. Applied by pw-cat (--target), parec (--device), arecord (-D). Falls back to MIC_PLUGIN_DEVICE.

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate in Hz (default 16000, or MIC_PLUGIN_RATE).

chunk_ms.description: Target duration of one streamed AudioStreamChunk in ms (default 100, or MIC_PLUGIN_CHUNK_MS).

stream_id.description: Pin the AudioStreamChunk stream_id (default: auto-allocated per session). Echoed in every chunk so the receiver can demux concurrent streams.
stream_id carried by every AudioStreamChunk of this session.

replaced.description: True when an existing capture session was stopped to start this one (single owner of the mic).

actions.name: mic_stop
actions.description: Stop a capture session by session_id, or every session currently capturing when omitted.

session_id.description: Stop this session specifically. Omit to stop everything currently capturing.

stopped.description: Ids of sessions that were stopped. Empty when nothing matched (stopping is idempotent). The final end_of_stream chunk is flushed to the peer after this response.

actions.name: mic_status
actions.description: Report active capture sessions and their targets. Read-only.

chunks_sent.description: Data chunks streamed so far (excluding the final end_of_stream marker).

MIC_PLUGIN_RECORDER.description: Pin one backend binary instead of auto-falling-through the chain.

MIC_PLUGIN_DEVICE.description: Default capture device/source; a per-call `device` param wins.

MIC_PLUGIN_RATE.description: Default sample rate in Hz (default 16000); a per-call `sample_rate_hz` param wins.

MIC_PLUGIN_CHANNELS.description: Default channel count (default 1); a per-call `num_channels` param wins.

MIC_PLUGIN_CHUNK_MS.description: Default chunk duration in ms (default 100); a per-call `chunk_ms` param wins.

MIC_PLUGIN_IPC_TARGETS.description: Comma-separated ipc_targets allowlist for streaming (T-04, e.g. "stt,device.phone.stt"). Default-deny — unset means mic_start can't stream anywhere.
